summary: Implemented the feature in the repository without running tests, flake8, or any repo code, and without committing. Changes: new monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver); nifti_writer default dtype changed to np.float32; plot_2d_or_3d_image added to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py; SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler rewritten as thin adapters (output_dir rename, filename parameter, index parameter); in-repo callers updated to output_dir; tests updated/added (test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py, updated test_handler_classification_saver.py). Static grep checks passed for line length (120), comma spacing, and file endings; no runtime verification was done. Docs under docs/source were not updated.
